text_description: Full runway look in a soft ivory/cream palette accented with sharp black edging, built as a sleeveless V-neck top over an asymmetric midi skirt. The top is close-cut through the torso with a deep V neckline bordered in black, narrow shoulder straps, and clean armholes; it extends into an angled, wrap-like hem that slants across the hips, forming layered triangular points at the front and side, all outlined with the same black trim. Beneath it, a fluid cream skirt falls from the waist/hip area to mid-calf with an asymmetrical, handkerchief-like hem; the skirt has visible layered panels and diagonal black-edged bands near the lower portion, creating a soft wave and uneven drop that is longer at one side. The overall silhouette is elongated and lightly draped rather than voluminous, with the crisp contrast trim emphasizing the neckline, waist overlay, and irregular hemline. Styling includes long loose hair, a small handheld leopard-print bag with a dark handle carried at the side, and delicate metallic/gold strappy heeled sandals wrapping around the feet and ankles.

Beneath it, a fluid cream skirt falls from the waist/hip area to mid-calf with an asymmetrical, handkerchief-like hem; the skirt has visible layered panels and diagonal black-edged bands near the lower portion, creating a soft wave and uneven drop that is longer at one side. The overall silhouette is elongated and lightly draped rather than voluminous, with the crisp contrast trim emphasizing the neckline, waist overlay, and irregular hemline. Styling includes long loose hair, a small handheld leopard-print bag with a dark handle carried at the side, and delicate metallic/gold strappy heeled sandals wrapping around the feet and ankles.
